title: AI-assisted DSA practice: new guidance and problem-solving flow
summary: Showcase CodeGrind's AI assist for problem-solving with Azure OpenAI integration, highlighting enhanced guidance, model switching, and a streamlined problem-solving workflow.
core_message: CodeGrind now combines LeetCode-style challenges with real-time AI assistance and a polished problem-solving flow. Switch models on the fly, get guided hints, and see how AI augments practice without leaving the editor.
cta: Try the AI-assisted mode on CodeGrind and share your problem-solving flow
visual_brief: A short, clean screen-recorded flow: editor on left, AI chat on right, problem pane top. Show typing of a hint, then progress towards solving a sample DSA problem. Include subtle Azure OpenAI branding and a progress indicator.
